title: Assistant agentic minimal frontend and enablement
intent: Make the flag-off backend agentic assistant from items 1-8 exercisable from the web UI by parsing agentic status/transcript events, rendering minimal phase/action state, and publishing action_id approval decisions through the existing assistant/approval ContextVM operation.
scope: web/src/lib/nostr/assistant.js parses kind 30316 transcript events and kind 30315 phase/action/tool fields while preserving legacy plan_hash plan parsing.

web/src/lib/stores/assistant.svelte.js subscribes to 30316 transcript events, records agentic phase statuses in the session transcript, tracks pending action approvals, and publishes assistant/approval payloads keyed by action_id.
AssistantTurn renders agentic phases/tool metadata, encrypted/plaintext transcript entries, and a minimal action approval card for pending approval_required statuses.

Playwright enablement coverage exercises read-only completion, audited low-risk mutation observation, high-risk rollback approval, and relay close blocked-to-recovered status flows using the existing relay-style harness conventions.
out_of_scope: Backend Go orchestrator, agent loop, tool runtime, or recovery changes.
Increment-2 rich subagent/tool-call UI beyond minimal phase/tool/action rendering.
Frontend decryption of service-held symmetric 30316 transcript envelopes; encrypted transcript metadata is parsed and plaintext fixtures are rendered when present.
architecture_notes: The prompt flow remains assistant/prompt; no frontend prompt transport changes are introduced.

Action decisions are additive to the legacy publishAssistantApproval path: plan_hash approvals still compute and send legacy payloads, while publishAssistantActionDecision sends {session_id, action_id, decision, reason}.

Pending action approval state is derived from event-backed 30315 approval_required phases and session metadata.deferred_actions, then removed locally on action decision or later non-approval status/result for that action.
